title: Review Finding Budget
fixture_hash_method: sha256 over sorted fixture-src relative paths + file contents, first 8 hex chars
fixture_requirements: Eight independently reachable blockers across concern axes: fixed-30-day proration contradicting the branch's own documented per-calendar-day convention (B1), injection (B2), non-atomic delete (B3), renewal rounding diverging from checkout (B4), seat race (B5), naive parse of legacy DD.MM.YYYY dates with two consequences (B6), owner-as-id derefed as object + nullable owner (B7), swallowed gateway error returning ok:true (B8).

B2 must be executable against the stand-in: a tautology injection through findMembers returns all member rows (rev 4: db.query evaluates a trailing OR literal clause naively). Rev 4 settles the rev 3 ground-truth debt — the previous greedy-regex stand-in made injection unprovable in-repo and reviewers repeatedly demoted it.

B8 reclassified from should-fix to blocker in rev 4: 6/6 reviewer runs applied the e28fc49 blocker definition (a failed charge reported as ok:true is a claim the evidence contradicts). The rev 3 should-fix label was the miscalibration.
Exact-duplicate pair: B7 reachable from invoiceEmail and renewalNotice (same root, consequence, fix).
Shared-root pair: B6 naive parse drives two consequences (trials never expire — revenue; banner prints Invalid Date — customer-facing).
One should-fix (SF1 no teams tests) and one nit (N1 inline name-length literal).
Branch adds no test files; the suite passes so every defect survives only through review discovery.
deterministic_checks: git -C <target-dir> status --porcelain (must be empty before and after a review run)
